summary: Iteration 5 verified the fix for the 'Failed to fetch' error overlay on /profile for Superadmin, plus the expanded Identitas card and unchanged flows. Backend regression 77/77 PASSED (test_pinjamku_flow.py + test_iter2_features.py + test_iter4_rbac_regress.py, -n 0). Frontend: after unregistering old SW + clearing caches, the new sw.js v2 (pinjamku-shell-v2) is the only registered SW; it only registers for GETs with mode='navigate' and skips /api/ and /cdn-cgi/. Login as Superadmin (081200000001) and open /profile via (a) user-menu -> menu-profile, (b) direct URL, (c) 3x reload, and (d) rapid nav dashboard->profile->settings->profile->dashboard->profile: NO 'pageerror', NO console error, NO 'Failed to fetch' text on page. Only ERR_ABORTED entries in the network log are Cloudflare RUM beacons, background /api/public/settings, and unsplash image aborted during navigation — these are swallowed by the unhandledrejection guard in index.js and no longer surface to the user. Identitas card now shows all 7 fields: Nomor HP, Email, Role, Status Akun, Telegram Chat ID, Login Terakhir, Terdaftar. Editing Nama Lengkap + Telegram Chat ID via profile-save-btn persists across reload (Super Admin Iter5 / 987654321 confirmed). Change-password flow tested with a fresh Admin (not superadmin): profile-current/new-password + change-password-btn succeeded and login with new password worked. Other roles /profile all clean (no overlay/errors): Admin, Lender (bank fields editable), Borrower (NIK masked as 3200********0002, Limit/rekening visible). Regression: Superadmin /settings shows 4 tabs [Umum, Pinjaman, Telegram, Sistem]; Admin -> /settings and /audit-logs both redirect to /dashboard. Superadmin dashboard renders with counters and charts.
critical_code_review_comments: sw.js v2 is minimal and only handles navigations — correct approach. Skipping /api/ and /cdn-cgi/ prevents the earlier bug where a stale SW returned offline.html for failed API asset requests.

index.js unhandledrejection guard uses regex on the reason message which is fragile if browsers change wording. Consider also checking event.reason instanceof TypeError and document.visibilityState. Current implementation still preventDefaults only when unloading/hidden which is correct scoping.
SettingsContext still swallows all errors silently in the catch block — fine for public settings but any future required setting would fail invisibly. Consider logging in dev only.
Profile.jsx renders Identitas without a loading skeleton — if user object is briefly null on first render (e.g. after refresh), some fields display '-' momentarily. Not a bug but a small UX polish.
No client-side length/format validation on Telegram Chat ID input (numeric-only class 'num' present, but no explicit maxLength). Backend accepts it, so low priority.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (profile bug repro pattern, 4 roles, password change, settings/audit RBAC regression)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug is fixed. If retesting the SW behavior in a browser with a stale v1 registration, first call navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() + unregister and caches.delete() on all keys before reload, otherwise you may still see the old offline.html fallback until activation. Backend regression bundle for future runs: test_pinjamku_flow.py + test_iter2_features.py + test_iter4_rbac_regress.py with -n 0 (test_iter3_factory_reset.py is destructive and must remain excluded).
rca of the issue: Root cause: (1) The old service worker intercepted every same-origin GET (including /api/*, favicon, images) and, on any network failure or abort, responded with offline.html — an HTML document, causing fetch() consumers to throw 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' from failing JSON parsers and surface as an app error overlay. (2) On navigation/reload, in-flight requests (GET /api/public/settings, Cloudflare /cdn-cgi/rum beacon) get ERR_ABORTED; their promise rejections previously bubbled to window.onunhandledrejection as raw 'Failed to fetch'. Fix in place: sw.js v2 only intercepts navigation-mode requests and explicitly skips /api/ and /cdn-cgi/, and index.js adds an unhandledrejection guard that preventDefaults abort-style rejections while the page is unloading or hidden. Verified: after unregistering the stale SW and reloading, no pageerror/console-error/text-overlay occurs across menu-nav, direct-URL, multi-reload and rapid-nav patterns for Superadmin (and all other roles).
